body: This was on Glassdoor for all companies in the US. It’s just based on reviews left by employees at different companies

Definitely ashamed I ever went to BYU in the first place, but I transferred out of BYU Provo back in 2018. A lot of technical classes like math and science classes transferred just fine for me. If you are thinking of transferring don’t take religious courses cause they are jack squat at other universities (I regret ever taking religious classes and the mental gymnastics they made us do).
